Name: SOCRadar Alarms Push
Author: SOCRadar - integration@socradar.io
Description:
The [SOCRadar](https://socradar.io/) alarms push solution for Microsoft Sentinel lets the SOCRadar platform send alarms to Microsoft Sentinel and raises one incident per OPEN alarm.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs.

 a. [Codeless Connector Framework push connectors](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-push-codeless-connector) (preview)

 b. [Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview)
WorkbookDescription: SOCRadar Alarms shows alarms by status, main type and severity, new alarms per day and the latest alarms.
